about: Swiss franc payments calendar: SIC's banking holidays (Swiss Interbank Clearing, run by SIX from Zurich), 1990-2100. The list is 'determined by the competent banking committees in consultation with SIX': New Year's Day, Berchtold's Day (January 2), Good Friday, Easter Monday, Labour Day (May 1), Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Swiss National Day (August 1), Christmas Day and St. Stephen's Day. A holiday on a weekend isn't moved, and two on one day are one day (Ascension on May 1, 2008). Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve are clearing days. SIX's published list (SIX-SIC) covers next year and is checked against these rules; Swiss National Day closes from 1994, the first year it was a federal public holiday. Years before 2026 are the rules unchecked against a published list.
